artifact.body:
Dear Ms. Weber,

Thank you for your inquiry regarding the sample kit for the Matte Series (Ref: NT-SMP-2026-04).

Status: The samples are currently undergoing final quality control checks at our Berlin warehouse. Due to a minor labeling adjustment, the release date has been shifted.

Next Step: The shipment is scheduled to leave our facility on February 10, 2026. You will receive a DHL tracking number via email on that date.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to your production schedule.

Best regards,

Nora Wells
Quality Support Employee
Nordton Export Desk
